svg.title: Windows 365 Enterprise grace period
svg.desc: Three events start a seven-day grace period on an Enterprise Cloud PC: the user is removed from the group that gives the license, a direct license is removed, or the user is removed from the group assigned to the provisioning policy. During the grace period the user can keep using the Cloud PC. You can restore the license, group membership or policy assignment, or end it with Deprovision now, which deletes the operating system and data. The Cloud PC utilization report helps find unused Cloud PCs.
svg.text: Find unused Cloud PCs (Intune admin center)
